title: Finish the lookup table
starter:
%i = param [] [0 4] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%days = stack 31 28 31 30
%out = index %days 0
hints: Two changes. The table needs a fifth entry, and the `index` should use `%i` where it now uses `0`.
If you only change `0` to `%i`, the program is rejected. `%i` can be 4, and a table of four entries has positions 0 to 3.
`%days = stack 31 28 31 30 31` and then `%out = index %days %i`. Now every value in the limits `[0 4]` is a real position.
explain: The limits `[0 4]` say `%i` is always 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4. A table of five entries has exactly those positions, so `index %days %i` is proven safe before anything runs. With only four entries the same line is rejected, because position 4 would not exist.
